home.practice_reactor_blurb: Swipe the core to fuse fuel rods, then push each hot rod out through an open port before the core goes critical.
reactor.title: Reactor
reactor.how_to: Swipe anywhere to slide every rod that way. Two rods of one grade that meet fuse into the next grade. After each swipe a new rod comes in on the edge the rods slid away from. A grade 4 rod is hot: it fuses with nothing. Swipe it against the wall where a port is open and it is discharged for the big score; that port closes and another opens. Four hot rods in the core at once and it scrams.
reactor.how_to_keyboard: Arrows or WASD swipe the core.
reactor.salvo_note: Hot rods lined up nose to tail at a port all go out in one swipe: two score two and a half times what they would apart, three score four times.
reactor.pipeline_note: Discharge again within eight swipes and the pipeline builds, up to double. The bar under the core counts the swipes you have left.
reactor.hint_note: Practice rounds point the way when a swipe would discharge a rod and you pause.
reactor.pressure_note: Hold two or more hot rods and the pressure gauge under the lamps climbs, a mark a swipe for each past the first; hold one or none and it lets a mark off. Fill it and the core scrams.
reactor.stage.core_intro: Swipe to fuse rods. A grade 4 rod is hot: push it out through an open port. Four hot rods at once and the core scrams.
reactor.stage.pipeline_intro: Discharge again within a few swipes and the pipeline builds, each rod worth more than the last. Keep the next one cooking.
reactor.stage.salvo_intro: Hot rods nose to tail at a port leave in one swipe, for far more than one by one. Hold one back to pair it, and mind the lamps.
reactor.stage.full_intro: A gauge under the lamps climbs while you hold two or more hot rods and eases while you hold one. Fill it and the core scrams.
reactor.legend_pressure: The gauge under the lamps is core pressure: a mark a swipe for each hot rod held past the first, one let off a swipe while you hold one or none. Hollow marks are what the next swipe adds if you keep them. Fill the bar and the core scrams, for the same loss as the lamps.
reactor.legend_hot: Hot rod. Fuses with nothing. Push it out through a port.
reactor.legend_port_idle: An open port: a gap in the wall at the end of the lane it serves.
reactor.legend_port_ready: Chevrons: a hot rod is at the front of the lane. Swipe that way.
reactor.legend_port_blocked: A bar: a hot rod is in the lane with another rod in its way.
reactor.legend_heat: The lamps over the core count hot rods. Light the diamond and the core scrams: it is emptied and you lose 150.
studio.preset.reactor_quick_rods: Grade 3 is hot: rods cook fast
studio.preset.reactor_no_holding: No holding: a second hot rod scrams the core
